mapper.select: SELECT accommodation_no AS acmNo, accommodation_name AS acmName, accommodation_address AS acmAddress, accommodation_contents AS contents, checkin AS checkinTime, checkout AS checkoutTime, tel AS acmTel, keyword_no, business_no, category_no FROM accommodation
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodation (accommodation_name, accommodation_address, tel, checkin, checkout, accommodation_contents ) VALUES (#{acmName}, #{acmAddress}, #{acmTel}, #{checkinTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{contents} )
